- On March 15, 2024, at approximately 2:30 PM, a silver 2020 Honda Accord driven by John Smith collided with a red 2019 Ford F-150 operated by Jane Doe at the intersection of Oak Street and 5th Avenue in Metro City.
- The Honda was traveling eastbound and failed to stop at a red traffic signal, striking the passenger side of the northbound Ford; road conditions were dry, visibility was clear, and witness statements corroborated the sequence of events.
- Both drivers sustained minor injuries and were transported to Metro General Hospital, both vehicles were towed due to disabling damage, and eastbound traffic was rerouted for approximately 90 minutes during the investigation and cleanup.
